entries.name: Demoralizing Shout
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Dominated Brawlers in the opening section.

entries.name: Shadowbolt Volley
entries.rationale: Stop the Voidtouched Magi group-damage cast.

entries.name: Violent Sand
entries.rationale: A named important interrupt from Angry Krolusks.

entries.name: Mad Shriek
entries.rationale: Stop the Kilivore Screamer cast before it disrupts the group.

entries.name: Mending Void
entries.rationale: Interrupt the Voidminder heal instead of extending the final trash section.

entries.name: Melt Armor
entries.rationale: Remove the Sycophantic Tarasek's Magic armor debuff from the tank.

entries.name: Corrosive Essence
entries.rationale: Cleanse the Poison applied by Agitated Voidscythes.

entries.name: Mind-Numbing Poison
entries.rationale: This is recovery for a failed Atroxus mechanic; avoid the application first, then cleanse affected players.

entries.name: Bolster
entries.rationale: Remove the Longtooth Tuskarr's Enrage; its low-level Enrage flag makes soothe the precise response.

provenance.description: Interrupt, dispel, purge, and boss priorities were independently summarized from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
Spell IDs, NPC contexts, dispel types, and Enrage flags are linked to the generated Midnight Season 2 ability index.
